title: Fourier square functional
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on $\{-1,1\}^n$ and a real weight $c(S)$ for every subset $S$ of the coordinate indices, define the Fourier square functional by $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}c(S)\widehat f(S)^2$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A real weight assigned to each subset of the coordinate indices
